mentions.name: CPPShader
mentions.description: A C++ library that lets developers write SIMD code using GLSL-like syntax. It currently requires SSE4, with planned SSE2 support for older CPUs (such as Core 2 Duo and Atom) and future NEON support for ARM.
mentions.source_excerpt: A C++ lib to write SIMD code like you would write GLSL: CPPShader https://github.com/gitdepierre/cppshader.
mentions.author: relssiegp
